title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Can I have this printer that's written off? And my gosh, how could you dump that whole pile of paper in the shredder? You can still write on the back!

title: Talk 1
original: Whoa whoa, Stay back. I just finished work, so I'm all sweaty. You need something? If it's not urgent, just go back to your office. Let me wash up and get a change of clothes, then I'll come talk to you.

title: Talk 2
original: Hahaha, Check me out! I made this whole outfit by myself. Yeah, it looks like crap, but it's sturdy! And you see this sickle?  I tore a door off a huge car to make it. I've used it for years, and it's good as new.

title: Talk 3
original: See that electric cooker of mine? I made it out of an old heater. And my space heater there, I made it out of an old TV. And As for the TV here, I put that together from the parts of a broken bread maker. Where did I get this bread maker? Aha, I modded an electric cooker I scavenged.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: The Pioneer guys are different from us. They get to wander around. Not us. Once you come to the disposal plant, you're staying forever.  Think you can run? Not happening, my friend. Look at your supplies, how far could you go? There's nothing but wasteland for miles. Your only shot at survival is staying inside.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: You have no idea how heartless those snobs are. They dump just about anyone in the disposal plant. Kids barely old enough to work, old folks in bad health. I can't stand it, but there's not much I can do other than making sure they get fed alongside me.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Doctor, remember that printer I took off your hands? Here, I fixed it. Oh, but keep an eye on the thermometer up top when you use it. If it goes over the threshold, it could explode.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Yeah, Doctor, I've got a temper, and I can't just sit by and watch bad things happen. In the end, I made the wrong enemies, and got thrown in the disposal plant. A whole decade came and went in the blink of an eye, like a nightmare... But now the dream's gone, and I'm awake! I don't regret it one bit. I'll keep my temper and make no compromises.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Ever since we were kids, if folks like us wanted to eat, we had to count on the scraps the snobs let slip from on high. Sadly, that's not enough to fill your stomach. So some folks end up stealing, naturally. That's not something anyone should do, I know. But if there was another way, why would you need to steal?

title: Idle
original: Whatever it is, it can wait until tomorrow! There's unlimited steak at the canteen today, I'd better get over there right away!

title: Onboard
original: Doctor, Rhodes Island has done so much for me. What can I say except thank you? If you need anything, just say the word. I'll do whatever it takes to make it happen!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Doctor, I can read a little bit, but the jargon in this video is pretty dense. I can barely make any sense of it.

title: Promotion 1
original: What? You're giving me a promotion? Me? For real? Hold up, what was I doing before this?

title: Promotion 2
original: Thanks, Doctor... If only my old man had lived long enough to see this day. His kid... always up to no good... has finally made a name for himself.

title: Added to Squad
original: Agh... It's been a while since I beat anyone up. Hope I didn't get too rusty.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Yeah, I can be the captain and chaperone these kids. I'll make sure all of them come back alive.

title: Depart
original: Stop right there, you little cubs! Don't just rush in ahead!

title: Begin Operation
original: You come at me like that, you can't blame me for what happens next.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Are you ready?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: I'm all set to go.

title: Deployment 1
original: Huh? I thought you wanted me here to fix a lock!

title: Deployment 2
original: Whose car is this? I... How should I know?

title: In Battle 1
original: A one-on-one? Tough guy, huh.

title: In Battle 2
original: What, you think you're gonna grind me down with numbers?

title: In Battle 3
original: There's more of you? Ugh, what a day.

title: In Battle 4
original: Arghhhh screw it! Bring it on, all of you!

title: 4-star Result
original: Ugh, I just hope these punks learned their lesson.

title: 3-star Result
original: No enemies in sight. But I'm sure they left behind some pretty good stuff.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: No, no, don't chase them. Just let them be. They got beaten so bad, they won't be causing trouble for a long while.

title: Operation Failure
original: Relax, nobody wins every fight. Go home, wash your face. Life goes on.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Man, this bed is too soft. I just can't fall asleep. Could you give me something firmer? That's how I like it.

title: Tap
original: Hm? Need some help? I'm your man.

title: Trust Tap
original: Here, I grabbed you some tangerines from the canteen.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: When I first got to that stinking place, I didn't celebrate any holidays. That's for men who still got something to look forward to. But the kids kept pestering me, asking me to make them some fireworks. In the end, I burned the whole tent... Save it. Thinking back, I guess it was pretty funny, hahaha.

title: Greeting
original: No matter how busy you are, be sure to eat right, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: It's your birthday, huh...? *sigh* I didn't know, so I didn't get you anything. How about this? I'll treat you to a feast tomorrow. Whatever you want. But uh... try to not order anything too expensive.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I sorted through tons of trash at the disposal center, for years. You can use most things after a little cleaning. If cleaning isn't enough, you can probably still fix it. If that doesn't do the trick, you can disassemble it and use its parts. That goes for people too, don't you think? No one out there's completely useless.
